OTECH 10GBASE-T SFP+ Module 1000/10000Mbps Copper RJ45 30M

The OTECH 10GBASE-T SFP+ Copper Module is a high-performance transceiver designed for 10G and 1G Ethernet connections over Cat6a/7 copper cabling. With support for both 1000Mbps and 10000Mbps speeds, it provides a flexible and cost-effective solution for short-range high-speed network deployments. This RJ45 SFP+ module delivers stable transmission over distances up to 30 meters, making it perfect for data centers, enterprise LANs, and top-of-rack switch applications.

Key Features:

  • Data Rates: 1000Mbps / 10000Mbps (1G/10G)

  • Interface: RJ45 Copper

  • Distance: Up to 30 meters (Cat6a/7 cable)

  • Standard: 10GBASE-T, IEEE 802.3an

  • Hot-swappable SFP+ form factor

  • Backward compatible with 1GBASE-T

  • Plug-and-play installation

Optimize your high-speed copper networking with the OTECH 10GBASE-T SFP+ RJ45 Module, ideal for environments where fiber is not practical but 10G speed is essential.
